situation: Got rejected after 4 rounds and a case study for a product designer role at a fintech; I really enjoyed the portfolio review with the team. The hiring manager, Lauren, was great throughout. I want to ask for feedback without sounding bitter.
reply: Hi Lauren, thanks for telling me directly, and for how thoughtful the whole process was; I really enjoyed the portfolio review with your team. Four rounds and a case study is a real investment on both sides, so if you're able to share it: was there one thing that would have tipped it my way? A single line is plenty, and it's fine if you can't. Congratulations on the hire.

situation: Tenho uma pequena agência em Lisboa. Fizemos proposta para o rebranding de uma rede de padarias e escolheram outra agência. O contacto era o Rui, diretor de marketing, que nos deu um briefing muito claro.
reply: Olá Rui, obrigada pela decisão e pelo briefing tão claro ao longo do processo. Se puder, gostava de saber se pesou mais o preço, a abordagem ou o encaixe, para apresentarmos melhor da próxima vez. Uma palavra chega. E se o projeto precisar de reforço mais à frente, estamos por cá.
note: Uma pergunta estreita e barata de responder tem mais hipóteses de receber resposta do que «tem algum feedback?».

situation: Final interview for an ops manager role at Larkfield General Hospital on Sept 10. Recruiter Dev said I'd hear by the 18th. Nothing. I sent a check-in on the 23rd, still nothing.
reply: Hi Dev, I'll take the silence as a no and close this on my end. Thanks for the conversations, and I'm open to talking again if anything changes.
note: This is the second and last touch. Then stop; if they come back months later, you can still say yes.

situation: 公司内部竞聘组长，我进了最后一轮但没选上，选了同组的小周。部门领导李总昨天花了半小时当面跟我说的结果，面试时他问得很细。我以后还要天天跟他们一起工作。
reply: 李总，谢谢您昨天专门抽半小时当面跟我说结果，面试时您问得很细，我也收获不少。结果我接受，小周当组长我会全力配合。想请您帮个小忙：下次再有类似机会，您觉得我最需要补的是哪一块？您哪天有空花十分钟聊聊就行，最近忙的话不着急。
note: 内部落选：公开支持胜出的同事，和请教反馈一样重要。

situation: Rejected for a senior PM role at Tidewell. I asked the hiring manager, Omar, for one thing that would have changed it. He said my product sense was strong but my answers on metrics were vague, and they needed someone who sets targets up front. It stings, but it's fair.
reply: That's useful, Omar, thank you for being straight with me. Naming the target and how I'd measure it before anything else is exactly what I'll work on. If the team is hiring again in the spring, I'd like another shot.
note: Replying to feedback that stings: thank him, repeat the point back so he knows it landed, and don't defend the old answers.

situation: 想申请明年的直博，给一所大学环境学院的周教授发邮件自荐，他看了我附的材料，很快回复说今年名额已经满了，建议我考虑其他老师。我还是很想跟他做土壤修复方向。
reply: 周老师您好，谢谢您这么快回复，还专门看了我的材料。今年名额的情况我明白了。我对您组里土壤修复的工作一直很感兴趣，明年九月如果您组里有名额，我可以再给您发邮件吗？不方便的话不用回复。祝您工作顺利。
note: 学术场合同样适用：谢具体的事，一句接受，只提一个小请求，并允许对方不回。

situation: J'ai passé une journée d'évaluation pour un poste de commercial chez un distributeur de matériel médical à Lyon. La recruteuse, Camille, m'écrit que je ne suis pas retenu et me propose un appel de 15 minutes pour un retour. Je suis libre mardi 6 ou mercredi 7 octobre en fin de matinée.
reply: Bonjour Camille, merci pour votre réponse et pour la proposition d'appel, que j'accepte volontiers. Je comprends la décision. Est-ce que mardi 6 ou mercredi 7 octobre en fin de matinée vous conviendrait ? Quinze minutes, c'est parfait. Belle journée à vous.
note: Quand on vous propose un retour, la seule demande est de fixer le créneau ; pendant l'appel, écoutez et prenez des notes sans vous justifier.

situation: I'm a freelance journalist. I pitched a feature on rural bus cuts to Dana, features editor at Northline Magazine. She replied the same day: 'Not quite right for us, but thanks for thinking of us.' I'd really like to write for them eventually.
reply: Thanks for the quick answer, Dana, and for reading it. Understood on the bus piece. One quick question, only if it takes you under a minute: is there a kind of story you're short of in the next few issues? A single line is plenty, and it's fine to skip it.
note: A pitch rejection: ask what they need, not why they said no. Editors answer that question, and it makes the next pitch land.

situation: 9月15号在一家新能源车企面了产品运营岗位的最后一轮，HR王女士说9月22号前给结果，到今天一直没消息。想问一下，又怕显得太着急。
reply: 王女士您好，想跟您确认一下产品运营岗位的结果，之前您提到9月22日前会有消息。如果这次没有通过，回我一句就好，我也好安排后面的计划。感谢您这段时间的安排。
note: 过了对方给的日期几个工作日再问，只问一次，把“没通过”说成可以轻松回复的选项；一周后仍无回音就发结束语，不再追。

situation: Founder here. Kara, a partner at Northfield Ventures, passed on our seed round after two meetings; her question about repeat purchase rates changed how we track our pilot. We'll have three months of paying customers by January, and she's raising a new fund. Her email said 'too early for us, love the team.' I'd like her to invest later without sounding desperate.
reply: Thanks, Kara, and thank you for two genuinely useful meetings; your question about repeat purchase rates changed how we're tracking the pilot. Understood on timing. Would it be alright if I sent you a short update in January, once we have three months of paying customers? If not, no need to reply. Good luck with the new fund.
note: An investor pass is usually a timing no: ask for one permission to update, tied to a date and a milestone, and skip the feedback ask.

situation: My friend Nadia referred me for an analyst role at her company, Brightline. I got rejected after the second round yesterday, though I liked the team a lot. I want to thank her without making her feel bad or like she has to find out why.
reply: Hey Nadia, heard back from Brightline, it's a no after round two. Thank you for putting my name in, it got me a real interview and I liked the team a lot. Please don't feel you need to dig into it or put in a word, you've already done plenty. Drinks on me Friday?
note: The referrer is the relationship to protect: thank her, release her from chasing it, and take any feedback ask to the hiring manager instead.

situation: I interviewed for Marketing Manager at Fernhill Foods and had a great conversation with the hiring manager about their spring launches. The hiring manager, Grace, emailed that they went with someone with more team management experience, but suggested I apply for a Senior Marketing Specialist role opening next month. I'm deflated, but I'd consider it.
reply: Hi Grace, thanks for letting me know, and for thinking of me for the specialist role; I really enjoyed our conversation about the spring launches. I understand the decision. I'd like to be considered for the Senior Marketing Specialist position, so could you let me know when it opens? Good luck to your new manager.
note: Take the pointer seriously but don't commit to a lower title yet; ask to be considered, then judge the role once you see the pay and scope.

situation: I submitted a talk proposal to DevNorth, a regional developer conference, on how we split our monolith into services. The program chair, Elena, emailed that it wasn't selected this year out of 240 submissions. The conference is in March and I'm attending anyway; I'd really like to speak there one day.
reply: Thanks for letting me know, Elena, with 240 proposals to get through. Understood on this year's program. One quick question, only if it takes you under a minute: was there one thing that would have made the proposal stronger? A single line is plenty, and it's fine to skip it. I'll be in the audience in March either way.
note: A talk committee reads hundreds of proposals: one narrow question, and showing up anyway is what gets you remembered next year.

situation: I did a paid trial shift as a line cook at Harbour Street Kitchen last Friday. Head chef Tom texted today: 'Thanks for coming in, we've gone with someone with more pastry experience.' I learned a lot watching him run the pass on that busy Friday. It's a small restaurant scene here and I'll probably cross paths with him again.
reply: Thanks for letting me know, Tom, and for the trial shift; I learned a lot watching how you ran the pass on a busy Friday. Understood on the pastry side. If you're ever short on the line for a weekend or an event, I'd be glad to help out. All the best with the kitchen.
note: A text rejection gets a text-length reply: one specific thank-you, one line of acceptance, and one concrete way to work together later.

situation: 面了一家咨询公司的项目经理，HR林小姐今天打电话说我是第二人选，第一人选已经接了offer，如果有变化会再联系我。挺可惜的，我还是很想去。
reply: 林小姐您好，谢谢您今天专门打电话告诉我，还让我知道自己排在第二，这对我很有帮助。结果我理解。如果之后有变化，或者团队再招类似的项目经理，希望您能想到我，接下来几个月我都方便沟通。祝团队一切顺利。
note: 第二人选最值得保持联系：一句接受，只提一个请求（记得我），不问为什么，也不打听第一人选。

situation: 上周HR陈女士电话口头给了我数据分析师的offer，说这周发正式offer。今天她又打电话说公司冻结招聘，offer撤回了。我还没跟现公司提离职，挺失落的，想回条微信保持好印象。
reply: 陈女士您好，谢谢您今天专门打电话告诉我，也谢谢面试这段时间您的安排。招聘冻结的情况我理解。等这个岗位重新开放时，希望您能想到我。祝一切顺利。
note: 口头offer被撤回：只提一个请求，不追问原因。以后正式offer签字前先别提离职。

situation: Me rechazaron para unas prácticas de verano en un estudio de arquitectura en Valencia. La entrevista fue con la arquitecta Lucía Ferrer y estuvimos 20 minutos repasando mi portafolio, pero el rechazo llegó en un correo automático de RR. HH. sin nombre. Quiero escribirle a Lucía por LinkedIn para pedirle un consejo sobre el portafolio.
reply: Hola, Lucía: me llegó la respuesta sobre las prácticas y quería darte las gracias por los 20 minutos que dedicaste a repasar mi portafolio conmigo. Entiendo la decisión. Si tienes un momento, ¿qué sería lo primero que cambiarías del portafolio para la próxima convocatoria? Con una frase me basta, y si no tienes tiempo, lo entiendo perfectamente. Ojalá coincidamos más adelante.
note: Cuando el rechazo llega de un correo automático, la persona que te entrevistó es a quien vale la pena escribir.

situation: I run a small IT support firm. We've looked after Hollins & Reed, a 40-person accounting firm, for three years, and their operations director Mark just emailed that after a tender they're moving to a larger provider from January 1. Our best moment was moving their whole office to a new building last year without a day of downtime, and we're on contract until December 31.
reply: Hi Mark, thanks for telling us yourself, and for three good years; getting your whole office into the new building without a lost day is still one of my favourite jobs. Understood on the decision. If you're able to say, was it mainly price or the size of the team? One word is enough. We'll keep everything running as normal until 31 December and send you a handover plan in November so the switch is smooth for your people.
note: Losing an existing client: the calm handover is what they will remember, so promise it plainly and keep the feedback ask to one word.

situation: I applied to be a trustee at Eastside Food Bank, the local charity where I've volunteered on Saturdays for two years. The chair, Margaret, emailed that the board chose someone with an accounting background because they need a treasurer. I'm disappointed, but I'd like to keep volunteering and be considered next time.
reply: Hi Margaret, thanks for letting me know, and for telling me the reason. A treasurer makes a lot of sense for the board right now. I'll keep coming in on Saturdays, and I'd welcome being considered if another trustee place opens up. Please pass my congratulations to the new treasurer.
note: In a volunteer role you stay in the room after a no, so showing up as usual is the strongest reapplication.

situation: 面了一家互联网公司的产品经理，最后一轮前做了笔试作业，花了整个周末写了12页的方案，交给面试官陈经理。今天HR赵女士发邮件说没通过，没说原因。这几周都是赵女士帮我协调面试时间，我挺想知道方案哪里不行。
reply: 赵女士您好，谢谢告知结果，也谢谢您这几周一直帮我协调面试时间。结果我接受。想麻烦您一件小事：如果方便，能否请陈经理用一两句话说说我的笔试方案里最需要改进的一点？不方便也完全没关系。希望以后还有机会合作。
note: 作业投入越大，越要把反馈问题缩小到“一点”，对方才愿意回。

situation: I just finished a 12-week summer internship on the data team at Corvel Health, where I built the churn dashboard. My manager Ben told me on a call today there's no return offer because of headcount, not my performance, and said he'd happily be a reference. I want to thank him and take him up on that.
reply: Hi Ben, thanks for telling me yourself today, and for a summer where I learned more than in any class, especially getting to own the churn dashboard. I understand about the headcount. I'd love to take you up on your offer to be a reference, and I'll give you a heads-up before I list you anywhere. I hope our paths cross again.
note: When they have already offered something, the one ask is simply accepting it; save the 'keep me in mind' for later.

situation: 面了一家物流公司的运营专员，面试官王经理跟我聊了一个小时，挺投机。今天HR刘女士打电话说，我的经验比岗位要求高太多，怕我待不久，所以没录用，还提到他们明年可能会招运营主管。其实我是真心想换行业从基层做起，但不想跟她争。
reply: 刘女士您好，谢谢您今天专门打电话告诉我，也谢谢王经理面试时花了一个小时跟我聊，收获很多。结果我理解。您提到明年可能会招运营主管，到时候如果合适，希望您能想到我。祝一切顺利。
note: 被说“资历过高”时不去辩解自己会待得住，只提一个请求，把门留给更匹配的岗位。

situation: My former manager Rachel, who I worked under for three years at Copperline, is now a director at Quill Health and interviewed me for a team lead role. She called today to say they went with an internal candidate. We still get coffee every couple of months and I don't want this to make things awkward.
reply: Hi Rachel, thanks for calling me yourself today; I'd much rather hear it from you than from an email. Going with someone internal makes complete sense, and no hard feelings at all. If another lead role opens on your team, I'd like to be considered. Our next coffee is still on me.
note: With a former boss, protect the friendship first: say the no changes nothing between you, then make one small ask.

situation: 我写了一部二十万字的悬疑小说，投给一家出版社，编辑周老师读完了全稿，还跟我通了半小时电话，她提的修改建议我觉得很有用。今天她发邮件说选题会没通过，说这类题材今年做得比较多。我在写下一本，也是悬疑，想以后还能投给她。
reply: 周老师您好，谢谢您告诉我结果，也谢谢您读完了全稿，还专门花半小时跟我通电话，您提的修改建议对我很有用。选题会的决定我理解。我正在写下一本悬疑，写完以后可以再发给您看看吗？不方便的话不用回复。祝工作顺利。
note: 退稿多半是选题时机的问题：谢她读全稿和那通电话，只提一个请求，不问为什么。

situation: 我是一家做乡村图书角的公益组织的项目负责人小田。我们申请了一家基金会的年度资助，项目官员何女士发邮件说没获批，今年只资助了8个项目，我们排第11。下一轮明年3月开放，我想以后还能申请。
reply: 何女士您好，谢谢您告知结果，也谢谢您告诉我们排在第11位，这让我们心里有数。评审的决定我们理解。想请教一点，只占用您一分钟：如果明年3月再申请，您觉得我们的申请书最该加强的是哪一处？一句话就够，不方便说也完全没关系。祝工作顺利。小田
note: 资助落选和求职一样：谢具体的事，一句接受，只问一个窄问题，并允许对方不答。

situation: Aldergate Foods turned me down for a supply chain analyst role after three interviews, which the recruiter, Hannah, had rescheduled twice to fit around my notice period. Last night I replied 'I'm surprised, I thought it went really well and I have more experience than most applicants.' I regret it and want to repair it.
reply: Hi Hannah, I want to follow up on my email last night. I wrote it while disappointed, and it came across as a complaint, which wasn't fair to you or the panel. I accept the decision, and thank you for rescheduling the interviews twice around my notice period. I'd welcome being considered for future roles at Aldergate.
note: Repairing a bitter reply: own it in one line, don't re-argue the decision, then send the gracious close you'd have sent first.

situation: 我叫赵磊，被裁员五个月了，这是第二十几次被拒：一家咨询公司的分析师岗位，HR张小姐今天邮件通知没通过，案例面试前她还提前把题目背景发给我准备。钱快花完了，我最近觉得撑不下去，但还是想体面地回一封。
reply:
张小姐您好，谢谢您告知结果，也谢谢案例面试前提前发来背景资料，让我准备得很充分。结果我接受。以后如有合适的分析师岗位，希望您能想到我。祝工作顺利。
赵磊
note: 这封回信短而得体就够了，不提自己的处境。但“撑不下去”的感觉要当回事：今天就跟信任的人说一声，或拨打当地的心理援助热线；失业期间的生活困难，可以向当地社保或街道咨询失业保险和救助。

situation: 我叫何佳。猎头赵女士把我推荐给一家咨询公司的分析师岗位，一直走到终面，每轮前她都帮我模拟面试。今天她打电话说客户选了别人。我想谢谢她，并请她以后有类似的分析师岗位继续想着我。
reply:
赵女士您好，谢谢您今天打电话告诉我，也谢谢每轮面试前您都帮我模拟，终面我准备得很踏实。结果我理解。接下来几个月如果有类似的分析师岗位，希望您还能想到我，需要的话我随时把更新的简历发给您。
何佳
note: 被猎头推荐的岗位落选：要维护的是和猎头的关系，谢她具体的付出，只提一个请求（继续推荐），不让她去追问客户原因。

situation: 地方の食品メーカーの営業職で最終面接まで進みましたが、今日、人事の佐藤さんから不採用のメールが届きました。最終面接では工場見学までさせてもらい、とても印象に残っています。理由は聞かずに、お礼と、また募集があれば応募したいことだけ伝えたいです。私は田中です。
reply:
佐藤様
ご連絡いただき、ありがとうございました。結果について、承知いたしました。最終面接の際に工場見学までさせていただいたことが、強く印象に残っております。また営業職の募集がございましたら、改めて応募させていただければ幸いです。貴社のますますのご発展をお祈りしております。
田中
note: 理由を尋ねないと決めたなら、依頼は「また応募したい」の一つだけ。具体的なお礼が次の募集で思い出してもらうきっかけになる。

situation: I interviewed for a senior UX designer role at Brightfield. The hiring manager, Sophie, emailed that they're hiring someone with more research leadership for the senior role, but she'd like to talk to me about a mid-level designer role on the same team that opens in November. I enjoyed the design critique session with her team and I'm open to it, but I'd want to know the scope and pay band before deciding.
reply: Hi Sophie, thanks for letting me know, and understood on the senior role. I really enjoyed the design critique with your team, so I'm glad you thought of me for the mid-level one. I'd be happy to hear more: could we have a short call next week where you walk me through the scope and the pay band? Thanks again.
note: Accept the no in one line, then treat the other role as a fresh conversation: ask for scope and pay before committing to anything.

situation: Ich heiße Miriam und habe beim Vorsingen für den Kammerchor Vox Nova gesungen; das gemeinsame Einsingen mit der Gruppe hat mir sehr gefallen. Die Chorleiterin, Frau Keller, schreibt, dass es diesmal nicht geklappt hat, weil der Alt voll besetzt ist, und dass das nächste Vorsingen im März ist. Da will ich unbedingt wieder antreten.
reply: Liebe Frau Keller, vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht und für das Einsingen mit der Gruppe, das hat mir richtig Freude gemacht. Ich verstehe, dass der Alt gerade voll besetzt ist. Eine kurze Frage, nur wenn Sie eine Minute haben: Gibt es eine Sache, an der ich bis zum Vorsingen im März arbeiten sollte? Ein Satz genügt, und wenn Sie dazu nichts sagen möchten, ist das völlig in Ordnung. Viele Grüße, Miriam
note: Absage nach einem Vorsingen: für etwas Konkretes danken, den Grund nicht anzweifeln und genau eine kleine Frage für das nächste Mal stellen.

situation: I'm Arjun, on a graduate visa that ends in June. I interviewed for a junior data engineer role at Pellow Systems and really enjoyed the pairing exercise with their engineer, Kim. The recruiter, Laura, emailed that they liked me but can't sponsor the work visa I'd need from June; I'd like to hear if that ever changes.
reply:
Hi Laura, thanks for letting me know, and for being clear about the reason. I really enjoyed the pairing exercise with Kim. I understand about sponsorship. If Pellow's position on sponsoring visas ever changes, would you let me know? I'd be glad to talk again.
Arjun
note: A structural no isn't about you: don't argue for an exception, just leave one easy door open.

situation: 我叫阿禾，做手工冷泡茶包。上个月给杭州一家买手店“山野集”寄了样品，主理人林姐亲自试喝了，还在电话里花二十分钟给我提了包装建议。今天她微信说这次不进货，今年店里茶类已经有两个品牌了。我明年春天会出新包装，想以后还能合作。
reply: 林姐，谢谢您告诉我，也谢谢您亲自试喝样品，还花二十分钟给我提包装建议，我都记下了。今年茶类已经满了，我理解。明年春天我会出新包装，到时候可以再给您寄一份样品吗？不方便的话不用回我。祝店里生意越来越好。阿禾
note: 买手店不进货：她已经给了原因，就不再问为什么，谢具体的事，只提一个带时间点的小请求。

situation: 我叫苏晴，面了一家医药公司的财务分析岗，薪资都谈好了，进入了背调。今天HR孙女士说背调后决定不录用，没说原因；这一个月来各轮面试都是她帮我安排的。我担心是前公司把我的离职日期记错了，我手上有离职证明，写的是2025年6月30日离职。
reply:
孙女士您好，谢谢您告知结果，也谢谢这一个月来您帮我安排各轮面试。结果我尊重。只想确认一点：如果这次的决定和背调中的某项信息有关，方便告诉我是哪一项吗？我手上有前公司开的离职证明，写明2025年6月30日离职，如果是信息有出入，我可以提供。不方便说也完全理解。
苏晴
note: 背调后被拒可能是信息有误：只问一个窄问题，主动提出可以提供证明，不争论决定本身。

situation: I'm Maya, 16, and I applied for my first Saturday job at Ferngrove Garden Centre. The manager, Mr Patel, interviewed me for 15 minutes and showed me round the plant nursery, and today he emailed that they went with someone who can also work Sundays. In the interview he mentioned they take on extra Saturday staff in the run-up to Christmas.
reply:
Hi Mr Patel, thank you for letting me know, and for showing me round the plant nursery during the interview. I understand you needed someone for Sundays too. You mentioned you take on extra Saturday staff before Christmas: could you keep me in mind for that? Thanks again,
Maya
note: A first-job rejection: one specific thank-you, no explaining your availability, and one concrete door to keep open.

situation: 我叫许诺。面了三轮青岚科技的前端开发岗，今天HR赵女士发邮件说没通过，最后选了有支付系统经验的候选人。整个流程安排得很好，二面的面试官还专门给我讲了他们的组件规范，我收获挺大。想回一封邮件。
reply:
赵女士您好，谢谢您告知结果，也谢谢这三轮安排得这么周到，二面时面试官给我讲组件规范那一段让我收获很大。如果方便，想请您或面试官给我一句反馈，看我哪方面最需要加强。不方便也完全没关系，以后青岚科技如果有合适的岗位，很希望还能收到您的消息。
许诺
note: 被拒后只回一次：具体的感谢、请一句反馈、留个门，然后就停。

situation: 我叫林可。面了一家设计公司的UI设计师，三轮下来没通过，面试官周总监在作品集环节花了快一个小时给我提建议。今天他微信说选了更有B端经验的人，还问我身边有没有做B端的设计师可以推荐。我的前同事小苏正好在看机会，也同意我把她的作品集转给他。
reply:
周总监，谢谢您告诉我结果，也谢谢作品集环节您花了快一个小时给我提建议，我都记下了。结果我理解。说到B端设计师，我的前同事小苏正好在看机会，她也同意我推荐，我把她的作品集转给您。以后如果有适合我的岗位，希望还能跟您聊聊。
林可
note: 对方请你推荐人时，先征得被推荐人同意；自己的请求仍然只留一个。
